root_cause.text: The `spi-amlogic-spifc-a4` driver's probe function (`aml_sfc_probe`) registers an on-host NAND ECC engine but fails to unregister it during probe failure unwinding or device removal.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `devm_add_action_or_reset` call to register `aml_sfc_unregister_ecc_engine` (which calls `nand_ecc_unregister_on_host_hw_engine`) to ensure automatic cleanup during probe failures and device removal.
